title_candidates: Pasted File Editor keeps long pasted text out of your draft
summary: Simon Willison built a small browser tool that turns long pasted text and copied files into separate previewable attachments instead of mixing them into the editor.

primary_source.title: Pasted File Editor
primary_source.author: Simon Willison
key_facts: The tool turns long pasted text into a separate attachment.
Users can attach, drag, preview, and independently remove files.
The tool is available publicly without an account.

prerequisites: A long piece of non-sensitive text

steps.instruction: Paste long text, inspect its attachment preview, and remove it without changing the draft.

risk_flags: Use only non-sensitive content in public browser tools.
